column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Heaven of the heavens” is rendered “highest heavens.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Smoke” is rendered “clouds,” and “doing his word” as “fulfilling His word.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Officials” is rendered “Princes,” and “rulers” as “judges.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Young women” is rendered “virgins,” and “youths” as “children.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A people, his kinsmen” is rendered “a people near to Him.”
